title: UPC Coding Set Manifest
description: manifest.json for a coding pass (codings/<set-id>/manifest.json), whose items.jsonl lines each validate against coding.schema.json. The manifest is where coder identity is DECLARED: coding.coder is a stable handle, and the volatile detail behind it (which model, which prompt version, which person) lives here, so a model upgrade does not re-mint coding ids or destroy inter-rater history.

set_id.description: Set identifier, e.g. cds-<slug> or a content id.

query.description: The question or task that defines this coding pass.

items_path.description: Corpus-relative path to items.jsonl for this set.

codebook_refs.description: Codebooks this set draws on (advisory index).

coders.description: Every coder handle used by this set. A coding whose coder is not declared here raises the advisory coding_coder_undeclared (§08).

kind.description: What sort of rater this is. §09 requires a code never to be shown without its coder, so a reader can tell one model's guess from a human's judgement.

model.description: Volatile: the model behind a model coder. Lives here, not in the coding id.
